name: Canna glass noodles
summary: Miến dong is a clear, thin, chewy noodle made from canna root.
origin: Nguyen Binh and the western road. Phja Den is the gift name.
howToEat: Have it in a chicken or pork-bone soup, as a mixed fry, or in fried rolls on the western road, and take the black Phja Đén noodles home as a gift.
where: Nguyen Binh and the western road.
seoDescription: Miến dong is a clear, thin, chewy noodle made from canna root.
